Messages.Author: ML2010
Messages.Body:
Im pretty new to this game and have, as you may have guessed, a plethora
of queries.
1. Can a vampire who's tapped with haven uncoverd or bloodhunt on him
defend himself if attacked?
2. if a blocking vampire has more intercept than the bleeders stealth do
they still go to combat?
3. do cards like ascention, minion tap, gird minions and effective
management get burned after you play them?
4. Does a vampire who calls a vote get to vote or does he just get the
vote from the vote card?

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
ML2010 <ml2...@aol.com> wrote:
>1. Can a vampire who's tapped with haven uncoverd or bloodhunt on him
>defend himself if attacked?

Sure.

>2. if a blocking vampire has more intercept than the bleeders stealth do
>they still go to combat?

Yes. All that you're checking is whether the intercept equals or exceeds
the stealth.

>3. do cards like ascention, minion tap, gird minions and effective
>management get burned after you play them?

Yes. Master cards are burned when used unless they say "play on
such-and-such", they are a skill or location, or they give a condition
for being burned or stolen.

>4. Does a vampire who calls a vote get to vote or does he just get the
>vote from the vote card?

Assuming you used a political card for the action (as opposed to, say, voting
to burn an Anarch Revolt), then you get a vote for that card, in addition
to whatever votes you generate normally. This can include using the acting
vampire to generate votes.

Messages.Author: Alec Habig
Messages.Body:
ML2010 <ml2...@aol.com> wrote:
>1. Can a vampire who's tapped with haven uncoverd or bloodhunt on him
>defend himself if attacked?

Sure.

>2. if a blocking vampire has more intercept than the bleeders stealth do
>they still go to combat?

That's the whole point of blocking. I block your action, which stops that
action, and we have a fight about it.

>3. do cards like ascention, minion tap, gird minions and effective
>management get burned after you play them?

Yep. Cards only stick around if they say so, or are equipment, location, ally,
or retainer cards.

>4. Does a vampire who calls a vote get to vote or does he just get the
>vote from the vote card?

He can vote (if he's titled), and gets the extra vote card vote too.

Messages.Author: James R. McClure Jr.
Messages.Body:
ml2...@aol.com (ML2010) wrote:
>1. Can a vampire who's tapped with haven uncoverd or bloodhunt on him
>defend himself if attacked?

Peace be with you,

Being tapped has no effect on a minions ability to do anything in combat.
Being tapped just shows that you have acted/blocked and cannot act/block
again until after the controlling Meth's next Untap Phase.

>2. if a blocking vampire has more intercept than the bleeders stealth do
>they still go to combat?

Yes, if the blocking minions intercept >= acting minion, then the action is
blocked and combat ensues.

>3. do cards like ascention, minion tap, gird minions and effective
>management get burned after you play them?

Yes, if a Master card does not say that it has a continuing effect (locations,
for example) it is burned after use.

>4. Does a vampire who calls a vote get to vote or does he just get the
>vote from the vote card?

The politial action card played to call a vote provides one vote for the Meth
controlling the acting minion. Vampires can only vote if they have titles or
play a card which grants them votes.
